watchFor: 異質系統的介面不只有電訊號。
記錄接地、功耗、時序及材料相容性。
標記畫面中未展示、仍需額外量測的界面。
watchForEn: Heterogeneous-system interfaces include more than signals.
Record grounds, power, timing and material compatibility.
Identify interfaces not shown that still require measurement.
videos.before: 先寫下本課的圖像判讀問題：異質系統的介面不只有電訊號。
videos.beforeEn: Write the visual-reading question for this course: Heterogeneous-system interfaces include more than signals.
videos.after: 完成觀察工作單，列出影片未能證明的三件事，並為每一件指定量測或來源。
videos.afterEn: Complete the worksheet. List three claims not established by the video and specify a measurement or source for each.

sources.title: Inside the Chip: Powering the Future of Advanced Packaging

watchFor: TSV 形成、填孔及晶粒堆疊是不同責任的工序。
凸塊均勻性與電鍍空洞需要各自的量測證據。
影片展示設備能力方向；沒有給出可投產的完整製程窗口。
watchForEn: TSV formation, via filling and die stacking are separate process responsibilities.
Bump uniformity and plating voids need different measurement evidence.
The video introduces equipment capabilities, not a complete qualified production window.
videos.scope: 本課「系統級封裝異質整合」的延伸背景。先進封裝設備與材料處理的共同背景；並非 TSMC、Intel 或每一特殊封裝的製程紀錄。 影片並非本課每一道步驟的實拍。
videos.scopeEn: Related background for System-in-package heterogeneous integration. Shared equipment and materials-processing context for advanced packaging, not a process record for TSMC, Intel or every package type. It is not footage of every step in this course.
videos.titleEn: Inside the Chip: How Lam Research Solves Advanced Packaging Challenges for the AI Era
videos.originalTitle: Inside the Chip: How Lam Research Solves Advanced Packaging Challenges for the AI Era
videos.author: Lam Research
videos.captionNote: 字幕與翻譯由原平台提供；下列中英重點由本學院依官方介紹另行撰寫，不是逐字稿或時間軸。
videos.captionNoteEn: Captions and translations depend on the source platform. The bilingual points are original academy guides based on official descriptions, not a transcript or timestamped account.
videos.before: 先問：「功能需求樹」需要哪種材料或介面證據？畫出本課與影片案例的共同處及不同處。
videos.beforeEn: Ask what material or interface evidence Functional requirement tree requires. Draw the common ground and differences between this course and the video case.
videos.after: 把「射頻隔離」列為查證任務：畫有意信號與非預期耦合路徑。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
videos.afterEn: Follow-up evidence task for RF isolation: Draw desired signals and unintended coupling. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.

courses.overview: 依接口學習相近工法：功能分割、異質接口與系統驗證。每個比較保留共同機制及不可直接轉移的邊界。
courses.overviewEn: Learn related methods through interfaces: Functional partitioning, heterogeneous interfaces and system validation. Each comparison retains both shared mechanisms and nontransferable boundaries.

related.title: 嵌入式晶粒封裝
related.why: 皆需將材料接口和功能测试共同設計
related.whyEn: Both co-design material interfaces and functional tests
related.transfer: 皆需將材料接口和功能测试共同設計
related.transferEn: Both co-design material interfaces and functional tests
related.difference: SiP 可採多種放置方式，嵌入晶粒是其中一種
related.differenceEn: SiP supports many assembly forms; embedding is one
practice: 以「功能需求樹」畫出兩課的材料或資料交接，標明共同基準。
比較「系統性能需拆成可量測的模組接口。」在另一工法下還缺少哪項邊界條件。
用本課的「把頻寬、延遲、功耗連到各元件。」設計一項可轉移和一項不可直接轉移的驗收證據。
practiceEn: Use functional requirement tree to draw material/data handoffs and shared datums.
Identify missing boundary conditions when applying this mechanism to the other process: System performance must become measurable module interfaces.
Using "Allocate bandwidth, latency and power to components.", define one transferable and one nontransferable acceptance item.

related.title: 共封裝光學交換器整合
related.why: 電、熱與光接口使跨域預算更重要
related.whyEn: Electrical, thermal and optical interfaces intensify cross-domain budgets
related.transfer: 電、熱與光接口使跨域預算更重要
related.transferEn: Electrical, thermal and optical interfaces intensify cross-domain budgets
related.difference: CPO 另外需要光耦合、光源與雷射安全
related.differenceEn: CPO additionally needs coupling, sources and laser safety
practice: 以「熱源共存」畫出兩課的材料或資料交接，標明共同基準。
比較「高功耗元件會升高鄰近敏感元件溫度。」在另一工法下還缺少哪項邊界條件。
用本課的「比較局部熱源開關的交叉溫升。」設計一項可轉移和一項不可直接轉移的驗收證據。
practiceEn: Use coexisting heat sources to draw material/data handoffs and shared datums.
Identify missing boundary conditions when applying this mechanism to the other process: High-power components warm sensitive neighbors.
Using "Compare cross-heating with individual sources toggled.", define one transferable and one nontransferable acceptance item.

history.textEn: Jason Chang and Richard Chang established ASE, whose first factory began operations in Kaohsiung.

history.title: 擴展半導體測試業務

history.title: 覆晶封裝進入量產

history.textEn: ASE’s history records volume flip-chip production, providing a milestone for comparing wire-bond and area-array interconnect approaches.
